group=io.swcode.urbo
# Kover builds its reports inside this JVM, not in a forked one. When a change touches only
# urbo-core and every other module comes FROM-CACHE, urbo-core's koverXmlReport and
# koverCachedVerify run side by side with the other modules' reports, and 1g ran out of heap
# on exactly those runs (#7827) while slower full builds stayed under it.
org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2g

# Reuse task outputs across builds instead of recompiling. Without this the CI cache is
# nearly worthless: restoring ~/.gradle/caches only avoids dependency downloads, and a
# measured warm CI run still executed all 1108 tasks with 0 FROM-CACHE, coming out 277s
# SLOWER than no cache at all because the 702 MB restore cost more than it saved (#6861).
# The local cache directory lives in ~/.gradle/caches/build-cache-1, which CI already
# persists, so enabling this is what makes that cache pay for itself.
org.gradle.caching=true

observation.command: grep -rn 'github' /workspace/backend/settings.gradle* 2>/dev/null | head; echo "==="; ls /workspace/backend; echo "==="; cat /workspace/backend/gradle.properties 2>/dev/null; grep -rn 'gpr' /workspace/backend/build.gradle* /workspace/backend/settings.gradle* 2>/dev/null | head -20
